INSERT INTO daily_metrics (business_day, timezone, active_users, new_users, plays, completes, paid_orders, revenue_cents, coin_spend, unlock_count, completion_rate) VALUES
(#{row.businessDay}, #{row.timezone}, #{row.activeUsers}, #{row.newUsers}, #{row.plays}, #{row.completes}, #{row.paidOrders}, #{row.revenueCents}, #{row.coinSpend}, #{row.unlockCount}, #{row.completionRate})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE timezone = VALUES(timezone), active_users = VALUES(active_users), new_users = VALUES(new_users), plays = VALUES(plays), completes = VALUES(completes), paid_orders = VALUES(paid_orders), revenue_cents = VALUES(revenue_cents), coin_spend = VALUES(coin_spend), unlock_count = VALUES(unlock_count), completion_rate = VALUES(completion_rate), updated_at = NOW()
